operator.action: perturb dependency latency or availability within an abort budget
operator.description: Apply a bounded delay or unavailable response at one dependency boundary and observe caller contract evidence.
operator.name: bounded latency or availability perturbation
operator.safety_boundary: local target only; abort before unbounded wait or external side effect

prior.description: Prioritize bounded latency, blocking, retry, I/O, lock, wait, or availability changes that cross a synchronous critical path.
prior.name: synchronous critical-path temporal propagation

operator.action: create or import one old state and run one bounded local upgrade/recovery epoch
operator.description: Create or import one historical state, then observe one bounded upgrade and recovery epoch at the recorded state boundary.
operator.name: bounded historical-state replay
operator.safety_boundary: local target only; reversible state and one attempt; abort before an unbounded wait, unsafe state, or external side effect

prior.description: Prioritize provenance-bound writer, durable-storage, schema-transition, reader, and recovery paths where historical state must remain compatible with a known quality contract.
prior.name: historical-state compatibility across recovery

operator.action: apply one bounded lifecycle or ownership boundary observation without an unbounded task or resource wait
operator.description: Observe one locally bounded cancellation, disposal, or lifecycle boundary while preserving the recorded resource owner.
operator.name: bounded lifecycle ownership drift
operator.safety_boundary: local target only; reversible fixture and one bounded attempt; abort before unsafe state or external side effect

prior.description: Prioritize lifecycle-bound coroutine, task, cancellation, close, and resource ownership paths whose lifetime may drift from the recorded quality contract.
prior.name: lifecycle and resource ownership drift
